preserved.title: Clear scope. A quote built around your operation.
preserved.intro: Cost depends on your cargo, volume, storage needs and delivery requirements.
preserved.note: Final scope and charges are confirmed in your quotation.

supplements.title: Make import-related items clear.
supplements.intro: Confirm the scope, then check how fees and taxes are itemized.
items: Confirm the service scope and handling responsibilities.
Confirm whether IOR support is needed and what is included.
Ask for the agreed service fees to be listed separately.
Confirm applicable amounts and whether they are included.

supplements.title: Check the conditions behind the quote.
supplements.intro: Agree when extra charges apply before confirming the plan.
items: Confirm the billing unit and any minimum charge.
Confirm the storage period, charging basis and when extra charges begin.
Confirm charges for special packing, labeling, inspection and returns work.
